create.title: Hard-M1 t=1 rho-large gcd-scaled double-close sector
create.statement_tex: Fix the exact accepted Round-192 hard-M1 t=1 core and its physical opposing-incidence source N=dm, N+r=d'm', with d,d' odd, 0<r<R_0, 2|r, d,m,d',m' comparable to L, all literal fields and zero extensions retained under one outer real part, and the literal T=0/T>=1 Farey-core convention unchanged. Put g=(d,d'), D_L=ceil(sqrt L), and P_cl=1_(|d-gm|<=D_L)1_(|d'-gm'|<=D_L) on the physical source before Fourier expansion or height differencing. In either primitive orientation the close relations imply S+w<=D_L/g and |kappa(U-v)|<=3D_L/g; the hard cone gives g=O(1), and the determinant confines S to O(1) integers after kappa,g,U,v,w are fixed. Hence the complete physical double-close set has at most O(LD_L log(2L)+LD_L^2)=O(L^2) atoms, with no hidden height or Fourier multiplicity. Rerun every accepted Round-187--Round-192 projector on P_cl W. Its safe proofs are deletion-stable; the affine-site identity retains the physical-mask commutator, births and deaths in the new core. Therefore |R_core(P_cl W)|<<_(B,C0,epsilon)L^2X^epsilon. The exact disjoint complement is P_1=1_(|d-gm|>D_L) and P_2=1_(|d-gm|<=D_L)1_(|d'-gm'|>D_L), and only P_cl is proved safe. For every 1<=D<=L the same absolute mechanism costs O((LD log(2L)+LD^2)X^epsilon), so width beyond sqrt L loses power. On the subsidiary sub-sector (m,m')=1 and r=2 mod 4, tau_g(d,m,d',m')=(gm,d/g,gm',d'/g) is an exact fixed-point-free character-reversing orientation involution after complete Fourier recombination, but this is not needed for the safe bound. This node proves no complete rho-large core, complete original t=1 or t>=2 range, owner, parent, endpoint theorem, bridge, target, or exponent.

Preserve the literal T=0 branch and, for T>=1, every simultaneous Farey-covector inequality; retain both orientations, the full anchor Fourier sum, unequal endpoint translations, residual selectors, all literal cells and crossings, carries, square-root phases, affine births/deaths, coprimality flips and zero extensions under one outer real part.
